title: Mobile Forensic Evidence BENCH™
meta_title: Mobile Forensic Evidence BENCH - Air Science Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers
meta_description: The Air Science Evidence BENCH™ series of laboratory work tables is designed specifically for high volume processing of forensic evidence by multiple users.
meta_keywords: mobile forensic evidence bench, forensic evidence processing, cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, air science equipment
short_description: The Air Science Evidence BENCH™ series of laboratory work tables is designed specifically for high volume processing of forensic evidence by multiple users. Professional design and construction features offer convenience during use, cleaning and maintenance.
full_description:
No positive airflow
Fabric withstands decontamination with standard bleach solution to eliminate blood-borne pathogens and DNA cross-contamination.
Cabinet includes plastic hangers, a plastic zipper designed for tamperproof seals, hanging rod, push handle, locking wheels, evidence tray and biological hazard warning label.
seo_content: The Air Science Evidence BENCH™ series provides a comprehensive solution for forensic investigation and processing, featuring a durable, easy-to-clean design that helps prevent cross-contamination. With a range of accessories and customization options, these mobile work tables are optimized for high-volume evidence processing in any forensic lab environment.
features_data: Fabric withstands decontamination with standard bleach solution
